sloka: यत्त्रयम् तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रम् तत्समम् भुवि ।नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते ॥२-३०-३४॥
transliteration: yattrayam tattrayo lokāḥ pavitram tatsamam bhuvi ।nānyadasti śubhāpāṅge tenedamabhirādhyate ॥2-30-34॥

translations.english: Where these three(mother,father and preceptor) equal to the three worlds are, O one with loverly sideglances, there is none in this world as holy. Therefore, they are to be worshipped.
translations.hindi: तब श्रीरामचन्द्र ने (आए हुए) लक्ष्मण से प्रसन्न हो. कर कहा--हे सोम्य ! तुम ठीक समय पर आ गए
